mode.description: Operating mode: 'live' for current kernel inspection, 'offline' for specified kernel files.

kernel_image.description: Path to the kernel image file (only used if mode is 'offline' or specified in live mode).

kernel_config.description: Path to the kernel config file (only used if mode is 'offline').

kernel_map.description: Path to the kernel System.map file (only used if mode is 'offline').

no_color.description: Don't use color codes in output.

explain.description: Produce additional human-readable explanation of mitigation actions.

paranoid.description: Require stricter mitigations (IBPB, SMT disabled, L1D flush).

no_sysfs.description: Don't use the /sys interface even if present.

allow_msr_write.description: Allow probing for write-only MSRs, which might produce kernel logs.

vmm.description: Override hypervisor detection: auto, yes, or no.

cpu_core.description: Interact with CPUID and MSR of a specific CPU core number (0-N) or 'all'.

variants.description: List of specific variants to check. If empty, all variants are checked.

cves.description: List of specific CVEs to check. If empty, all CVEs are checked.

output_format.description: Output format: normal, json, nrpe, prometheus, or short.

arch_prefix.description: Prefix for cross-inspecting a kernel of a different architecture.

coreos.description: Use ephemeral toolbox for CoreOS inspection.

update_fwdb.description: Update local copy of CPU microcodes versions database.

kernel_version.description: Placeholder for kernel version to construct default paths if kernel_image is empty.
